name: com.jlyt.hwsdk
description: Shared Unity module for the HW/GameBrain monetization SDK (AppLovin MAX based). Baselines: Android hwads 9.8.68, iOS HwAds 9.8.75. Supports Unity 2022.3 LTS and Unity 6000+ (below 2022.3 unsupported). Provides a unified cross-platform C# API, per-version dependency manifests and Editor build integration.
